title: Deriving proper/open support under all-sheaf finite cohomological dimension
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $p:V\to T$ a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $i:W\hookrightarrow T$ be an arbitrary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and set $U=V\times_TW$, with projections $k:U\hookrightarrow V$ and $r:U\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the uncompleted unbounded derived operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Assume $p$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and assume an integer $d\geq0$ satisfies $R^qp_*F=0$ for every pro-etale $A$-module sheaf $F$ on $V$ and $q>d$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\gamma:i_!r_*\xrightarrow{\sim}p_*k_!$ for the specified sheaf comparison [lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison], and use exact extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero, lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]. For $M\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, choose a K-injective representative $J$ with injective terms [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] and a K-injective resolution $k_!J\to I$. The map represented by
$$i_!r_*J\xrightarrow{\gamma_J}p_*k_!J\longrightarrow p_*I$$
defines an isomorphism $\Gamma_M:i_!Rr_*M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*k_!M$, independent of the choices and natural in $M$. With the canonical restriction isomorphism $\lambda$ of [lem-exc-proetale-derived-open-restriction], its specified normalization under $i_!\dashv i^*$ [prop-exc-open-adjoint] is
$$\lambda_M\circ i^*\Gamma_M=1_{Rr_*M},\qquad \Gamma_M=\varepsilon_i\circ i_!(\lambda_M^{-1}).$$
No quasi-compactness of $i$ or boundedness or etale-origin condition on $M$ is assumed.
